Definition: properly, to scrape out, but in certain peculiar senses (of removal or association)
BiblicalUsage: In 1 Samuel we find çâphach, the word for to scrape out. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâphach is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
